crossRefs.note: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope…
For Yahweh says: “Just as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that…
Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city…
Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He…
It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save…
But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you.…
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk…
In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his…
Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions
